scene.name: The Rainbow Maker
scene.text: After a passing shower, the Golden Child points toward the sky. One rainbow appears, then a second, and then a faint third arch. The children race to see where the colors touch the earth. The adults disagree about whether he summoned the sight or simply knew when to look.

text_only.reason: rule 8: a cosmetic weather wonder; the source gives no resource reward
